description: This file contains PHP code for displaying help content during the installation process of SuiteCRM, a CRM software. It defines classes and functions to generate HTML help screens for different installation steps, including prerequisite checks, database setup, configuration, and registration. The script also handles dynamic content based on user steps via query parameters.

classes.name: HelpItem
classes.description: A class representing a help item with associated field, title, and text.

methods.name: help_menu_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for the main help menu listing installation steps.

methods.name: format_help_items
methods.description: Formats an array of HelpItem objects into an HTML table.

methods.name: help_step_1_html
methods.description: Generates help content HTML for the first installation step, focusing on prerequisites.

methods.name: help_step_2_html
methods.description: Generates help content HTML for the database configuration step.

methods.name: help_step_3_html
methods.description: Generates help content HTML for the site configuration step.

methods.name: help_step_4_html
methods.description: Generates help content HTML for the installation process step.

methods.name: help_step_5_html
methods.description: Generates help content HTML for post-installation registration.
